text: AgentKit Studio（DSH 插件，Web 与桌面客户端）：用于创建和管理 Agent 的工作台。它接入 DSH 的 Agent、会话、资源与插件界面，并由 Host 侧服务处理 Agent 配置和运行管理。主要功能包括编辑 Agent 草稿并绑定模型、MCP 与 Skill 资源，浏览 Agent 目录及构建版本，创建本地构建和云端部署，以及配置团队并启动协作运行。适合需要在 DSH 中组织 Agent、资源和自动化任务的用户。使用前需要兼容的 DSH Host；云端部署还需配置云端子账号凭证。

AgentKit Studio is a DSH web and desktop workbench for creating and managing Agents. It supports Agent editing, model/MCP/Skill bindings, local builds, cloud deployment, and team runs. A compatible DSH Host is required; cloud deployment also needs configured subaccount credentials.

Help me bind model, MCP, and Skill resources to an Agent.
AgentKit Studio 的功能「Agent 草稿编辑」：通过 DSH 对话工具读取、创建或修改 Agent 草稿，并以修订号检查避免覆盖较新的编辑。 通过 Studio 的 Agent 与团队操作入口触发。
AgentKit Studio 的功能「Agent 目录」：按来源和关键词浏览受支持运行时的本地 Agent 及 Studio 云端部署，并分页返回结果。 通过 Studio 的 Agent 与团队操作入口触发。
AgentKit Studio 的功能「本地构建」：将 Agent 修订内容打包为带内容标识的构建归档，供本地运行流程使用。 通过 Studio 的 Agent 与团队操作入口触发。
AgentKit Studio 的功能「云端部署」：为本地 Agent Build 准备云端部署计划，并提供部署记录及状态管理。 通过 Studio 的 Agent 与团队操作入口触发。
AgentKit Studio 的功能「团队协作运行」：配置团队成员与职责，启动团队任务，并查看运行状态和成员结果。 通过 Studio 的 Agent 与团队操作入口触发。
@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio 提供命令 make
@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio 提供命令 node
@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio 提供工具 spawn_teammate：启动用户已选择的专家成员。仅主理人可调用，名称必须与团队配置一致。
@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio 提供工具 list_agents：读取官方团队成员及运行状态。
@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio 提供工具 send_message：向团队成员发送持久消息，inactive 成员会开始或继续执行。
@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio 提供工具 wait_agent：等待其他正在运行的成员产生变化。不会唤醒 inactive 成员；先发送消息再等待。
@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio 提供工具 interrupt_agent：停止指定成员当前回合，保留成员和历史。
@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio 提供工具 team_task_create：创建共享任务。
@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio 提供工具 team_task_list：读取共享任务及版本、负责人、依赖与状态。
@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio 提供工具 team_task_get：更新前读取共享任务的最新版本。
@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio 提供工具 team_task_update：使用最新 revision 修改任务。主理人可用 reassign 分配 owner。
@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio 提供工具 cloud_browser_open
@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio 提供工具 cloud_browser_snapshot

@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio README · AgentKit Studio：[官网与下载](https://kingsoftcloud.github.io/agentkit-studio/) · [文档索引](docs/README.md) · [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio/releases)

AgentKit Studio is a product plugin for the public [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) host. It provides Agent authoring, resource management, local conversations, deployment controls, automation, and plugin discovery in the Harness Web and desktop surfaces.

@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio README · AgentKit Studio：The Studio plugin is designed to run with the pinned DSH host version declared in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). This repository contains Studio code, compatibility patches, tests, and packaging scripts; it does not vendor the DSH source tree or user credentials.

@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio README · What it provides：- Agent creation and revision-based editing with model, MCP, Skill, knowledge, and memory bindings.
- Native DSH conversations for Studio, Codex, and Star Harness runtimes.
- Host-owned resource discovery and lifecycle operations.
- Build, deployment, automation, channel, and operational surfaces through typed Host APIs.
- DSH plugin discovery with curated official bundles and post-install capability checks.
- Portable build artifacts that keep credentials in the destination Host.

@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio README · What it provides：Studio Agents and Builds with `runtime.type = "harness"` use the independent
[ksadk-harness](https://github.com/kingsoftcloud/ksadk-harness) npm packages.
Native owns the execution loop and durable Run state; Studio supplies product
admission, model/resource/permission bindings and event projection. Core, Node
and UI source and release tests are maintained only in the independent repository.
Legacy Harness Builds must be recreated with a Native engine pin; they are not
reinterpreted or resumed through a DSH model interceptor.

@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio README · What it provides：Cloud features require a compatible AgentEngine control plane and credentials configured in the Host. A local test or a visible catalog entry does not prove access to a cloud resource.

@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio README · Install and use：Start with the [desktop and development guide](docs/getting-started.md), or browse
[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio/releases).
The [documentation index](docs/README.md) covers runtimes, plugin development,
signing and updates.

@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio README · Development setup：Requirements:

- Node.js `22.23.4` (or `24.22.1+`) with development headers
- pnpm `10.33.2`, Corepack, Git, Make, and a native compiler toolchain
- A checkout of the pinned DSH source tree, kept outside this repository

```sh
corepack enable
make setup DSH_ROOT=../deepseek-harness
make dev DSH_ROOT=../deepseek-harness
```

Use `DSH_HOME` and `AGENTKIT_HOME` to isolate local profiles and Studio data. Do not copy another user's profile or credentials into the repository.

@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio README · Development setup：`dist/` is generated locally and is not tracked in Git. `make dev` (or
`make web-dev`) rebuilds and installs the plugin before launch. Desktop build and
launch targets also build the client first. `pnpm check`, `pnpm test` and
`pnpm pack` rebuild it automatically; packaged plugins still include `dist/client.js`.

@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio README · Experts and cloud personal assistant：The Agents panel includes an original expert catalog, resource templates and local teams built on official DSH Agent Teams. Existing Agents still use the same editor, frozen revisions and native conversations. See [expert catalog and local teams](docs/expert-catalog.md).

@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio README · Experts and cloud personal assistant：The cloud personal assistant is now a separate DSH client plugin: install `@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-personal-assistant`. Studio keeps the Agent catalog, preset binding and the DSH Native cloud runtime that plugin talks to; the in-app assistant panel, its opening wizard and its desktop-side transport are no longer part of this repository.

@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio README · Checks：```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
make check
make pack
make release-check

`make check` runs syntax, portability, source-size, contract, and product-surface checks. `make release-check` additionally validates package contents, DSH patch format, and archive integrity.
`make public-gate` is the shared source, package, and public-surface gate used by
both forge pipelines. The read-only [`branch-sync.md`](docs/branch-sync.md)
contract describes the separate exact-ref parity check.

@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio README · Checks：The curated DSH plugin market can be verified against a real pinned Host in an isolated profile:

```sh
AGENTKIT_DSH_ROOT=/path/to/deepseek-harness \
AGENTKIT_DSH_HOME=/tmp/agentkit-studio-dsh \
pnpm verify-dsh-plugin-market --execute --all
```

The verification command does not approve dependency build scripts automatically and never uses a personal profile unless the caller explicitly supplies it.

@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio README · Repository layout：- `src/` — Studio Host and browser implementation
- `src/client/` — browser ES Modules with scoped state and page composition, bundled into `dist/client.js`
- `examples/` — minimal public configuration examples
- `docs/` — usage, architecture and release guides
- `patches/` — versioned compatibility patches for the pinned DSH release
- `scripts/` — build, package, portability, and Host verification tools
- `tests/` — unit, contract, packaging, and product-surface tests
- `docs/brand/` — public visual guidance

@kingsoftcloud/agentkit-studio README · Contributions：See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Changes that affect the Host contract, packaging, credentials, runtime behavior, or public release path need focused tests and fresh verification before review.
